body:
Verified from the cmd-line using a MSVC-built `curl.exe`.
Here:
```c
void Curl_ssl_sessionid_lock(struct connectdata *conn)
{
  if(SSLSESSION_SHARED(conn->data))
```

`conn->data == NULL`!
Could fb445a1e18d12f577964c9347bc5bca74b37cd08 and/or f3ce38739fa49008e36959aa8189c01ab1bad5b5 be related to this?

Full call stack:
```
Curl_ssl_sessionid_lock(connectdata * conn=0x000001d48f950560) Line 286
Curl_schannel_shutdown(connectdata * conn=0x000001d48f950560, int sockindex=0) Line 2017
Curl_ssl_shutdown(connectdata * conn=0x000001d48f950560, int sockindex=0) Line 560
Curl_schannel_close(connectdata * conn=0x000001d48f950560, int sockindex=0) Line 1922
Curl_ssl_close(connectdata * conn=0x000001d48f950560, int sockindex=0) Line 556
Curl_disconnect(Curl_easy * data=0x000001d48f91eef0, connectdata * conn=0x000001d48f950560, bool dead_connection=false) Line 804
Curl_conncache_close_all_connections(conncache * connc=0x000001d48a21d9b0) Line 580
curl_multi_cleanup(Curl_multi * multi=0x000001d48a21d8c0) Line 2287
```
Thanks. I'll look into it asap...

What happens is that `conn->data` gets set to `NULL` at https://github.com/curl/curl/blob/ba266b3ed74abecdc02e6b036e8bbf018e01ed9c/lib/url.c#L793 and the crash because of that happens at https://github.com/curl/curl/blob/ba266b3ed74abecdc02e6b036e8bbf018e01ed9c/lib/url.c#L802 then with the call stack posted above.

According to the comment, the assignment in your snippet is for `conn->handler->disconnect`, which is not even called.
@bagder Can you push that please? It's necessary for testing https://github.com/curl/curl/pull/3321.

body:
I'm still seeing something similar, even after https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/6ee672970972a40603d8141293ca91c4d4854187.

I think we may need to check that `data` is not `NULL` here:
https://github.com/curl/curl/blob/6ee672970972a40603d8141293ca91c4d4854187/lib/sendf.c#L264

...because `Curl_schannel_shutdown` also passes `data` to `failf`/`Curl_failf`. The `infof`/`Curl_infof` call already makes this check here:
https://github.com/curl/curl/blob/6ee672970972a40603d8141293ca91c4d4854187/lib/sendf.c#L235

However, it seems like anywhere we might call `failf`, it would be useful to have some context to be able to provide debugging information to the caller. So, maybe @bagder's hunch is correct, that we might need a more complete fix.
https://github.com/curl/curl/issues/3412#issuecomment-451314677

I don't have a proposed fix, but I think for now I'm just going to try checking for `data` here and seeing how far I get.
https://github.com/curl/curl/blob/6ee672970972a40603d8141293ca91c4d4854187/lib/vtls/schannel.c#L1965

@chris-araman

> [curl/lib/sendf.c]

That is close to where issue https://github.com/curl/curl/issues/3505 crashes too (at line 162).
Different function, but the maybe the assumptions WRT to Schannel are perhaps related?

issue.body:
Fixes: #3412 #3505

Ensures any TLS shutdown messages are sent before removing the association between the connection and the easy handle. Reverts @bagder's previous partial fix for #3412.

Note that `conn_free` also calls `Curl_ssl_close` on `PRIMARYSOCKET` and `SECONDARYSOCKET`, but that was the case before https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/fb445a1e18d12f577964c9347bc5bca74b37cd08.
